tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation decisively rejects the threshold-branch fit, but there is no reported chaotic oscillation or evidence of nonstationarity. The recalled source/inland-hub mechanism explicitly allows a linear leak branch; refit that compact stationary law numerically rather than buying another probe. This code still needs the execution harness to provide training rows to predict; the previous failed call shows that relying on an undefined global is unsafe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations already cover eight input/gradient combinations at the target horizon; the sharp mismatch is not evidence of a short-horizon ambiguity.
Every paid row has H=0.8 and identical memory/state inputs, while the response changes systematically with u_now and s_grad; temporal mechanisms are not motivated by this evidence.
Fresh confirmation refuted the threshold model despite its good training fit, so repeating a flexible threshold fit is not justified.
Selected as the simplest recalled mechanism able to capture the observed negative high-gradient response through the documented mass-drift branch.
